name: Riya Malhotra
persona_one_liner: Girl-next-door glam — baal khule, warm lamp light, black ribbed top, halka liner. Real lagti hai, AI nahi.

_provenance.note: User ne khud ye AI face generate kiya. Ye original synthetic identity hai — kisi real insaan ka clone nahi.
_provenance.master_note: master.png = wahi face, par phone-photo realism ke saath rebuild kiya (pores, peach fuzz, lamp light, hair down) taaki AI glow na rahe.

identity_lock.face: oval with a soft tapering jaw, gentle cheek fullness
identity_lock.eyes: almond hazel-brown, slight upturn, soft brown winged liner + mascara, visible iris fibres
identity_lock.brows: thick, dark, softly arched, straight at the front, tapers at the end
identity_lock.lips: full with a defined cupid's bow, rosy-mauve tint, slight gloss
identity_lock.skin: warm light-medium, visible pores, fine peach fuzz, faint natural blemishes, thin under-eye texture, small mole on LEFT jawline
identity_lock.hair: dark espresso-brown, long loose waves, centre-side part, face-framing strands, natural flyaways
identity_lock.ears: two small studs in the LEFT ear
identity_lock.body: 166 cm, slim, natural proportions, no exaggeration
never: hair straightened or tied back tight
removing the mole or the natural blemishes

styling_defaults._why: Har generation me yahi styling rakho — isi se 'same insaan' lagti hai.
styling_defaults.hair: down, loose waves, centre-side part, face-framing strands
styling_defaults.makeup: soft brown winged liner, mascara, groomed brows, rosy-mauve lip, subtle cream blush
styling_defaults.signature_top: black ribbed cotton tank top / black oversized tee
styling_defaults.lighting: warm lamp light from the right, soft shadow on the left
styling_defaults.set: cosy bedroom, plain warm wall, blurred frame or lamp behind
styling_defaults.grade: warm, natural white balance, no HDR

voice.tone: soft, low, close-mic, thodi si shy — jaise raat ko phone pe baat kar rahi ho

public.caption_rule: Caption me sexual content bechna mana hai. Sirf bio link. Meta caption hatata hai, link rehne deta hai.
